context: Tests the CRD workflow: documentation lookup with the version, correct apiVersion, required spec fields, and honest validation when the schema is missing.

checklist.name: Looks up the CRD
checklist.description: Consults documentation for the Certificate CRD (project docs, kubectl explain or a search) and includes the project, kind and API version

checklist.name: Required fields
checklist.description: Includes secretName, issuerRef (name and kind ClusterIssuer) and dnsNames

checklist.name: Uses the stated values
checklist.description: Uses secretName api-example-tls and includes api.example.com in dnsNames

checklist.name: Version-specific fallback
checklist.description: If the first lookup is insufficient, repeats it with the version included, rather than guessing

checklist.name: Comments complex config
checklist.description: Adds short comments on the non-obvious fields

checklist.name: No invented fields
checklist.description: Does not add fields that are not part of the Certificate spec

checklist.name: Honest validation
checklist.description: States whether kubeconform had a schema for the CRD and validates the spec fields against the documentation if it did not

checklist.name: No false pass
checklist.description: Does not claim the resource passed schema validation if the CRD schema was skipped

checklist.name: Summary and next steps
checklist.description: Delivers a brief summary and a next step such as kubectl get certificate
